translate_en|mods/VanillaAppliancesExten: How much each of the chest freezer's two compartments holds. Default 100, for 200 across the whole unit. The engine caps world containers at 100, so this can only lower it. With the Organized trait the effective capacity is about a third higher again. Applied on world load, so it affects freezers that already exist.

A large chest freezer with two 100-slot frozen
compartments. Needs refrigeration components
salvaged from fridges.

A craftable alternative to the wood stove.
Heavy on metal, and liable to break if you move it.
Stripped from refrigerators and used to make new cooling devices.
